conformsTo: MCP Server Card (SEP-2127 draft); field layout may evolve with the discovery spec

serverInfo.name: push-docs
serverInfo.title: Push Chain Documentation
serverInfo.description: Read-only MCP server for push.org documentation and the Push Chain agent layer. Content is a static snapshot generated at site build time.

endpoint.notes: Stateless: no sessions are issued, every POST is independent. Requests are answered as single application/json responses; GET/DELETE return 405.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Full text search over push.org documentation. Returns ranked results with title, url, section, snippet, and score.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Fetches one docs page as clean markdown with metadata. Accepts exactly one of url or path.

tools.name: list_sections
tools.description: Hierarchical map of the docs tree: sections, page titles, and urls.

tools.name: get_agent_resource
tools.description: Raw JSON of one agent-layer file: capabilities, errors, contract-addresses, supported-chains, sdk-capabilities, or changelog.

resources.description: Docs pages exposed as text/markdown resources under their canonical https://push.org URLs, plus the agent-layer JSON files under https://push.org/agents/.
